name: datacleanist
description: Deterministic data-quality analysis (EDA) for tabular files: missing values, duplicates, outliers, correlations, VIF, mutual information, leakage checks, and an interactive report dashboard.

interface.longDescription:
DataCleanist analyzes tabular data files (CSV, TSV, Excel) and produces a deterministic exploratory data analysis: missing values, duplicates, outliers, distributions, correlations, VIF, mutual information, leakage suspects, PII flags, and a 0-100 data quality score with a five-dimension breakdown. Every number is computed by real code from the file itself - never estimated by a language model - and arrives with an interactive report card (Deep Dive statistics, per-column inspection, scatter explorer) rendered in the conversation.

Intended users: data scientists, analysts, and ML engineers who want to understand and quality-check a dataset before modeling or cleaning it.

Limitations: in-chat files up to 50 MB, 200,000 rows, and 300 columns; each user gets 5 analyses per rolling 30-day window; the tools analyze files - they do not clean, transform, export, or email data, and follow-up answers quote the computed summary rather than re-deriving statistics. Uploaded data is deleted automatically (raw files within 24 hours, derived outputs within 7 days) and is never used to train models. The full product - larger files, data cleaning, and chat - is available at datacleanist.com.
defaultPrompt: Analyze this CSV and give me the full EDA report
Which columns have missing values and can I trust them?
Show me a demo of DataCleanist on a sample dataset

positive.description: Full EDA on an attached dataset
positive.prompt: Give me the full EDA report for the attached dataset.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports the engine's computed results for the attached file - 891 rows x 12 columns, quality score 75/100, Cabin ~77% missing - and renders the interactive report card widget (Overview tab with quality breakdown and KPI tiles).

positive.prompt: Show me a demo of DataCleanist first.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the bundled Titanic sample, analyzes it with the deterministic engine, and renders the report card.

positive.prompt: Which columns have missing values, and is that missingness random?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the columns with real missing counts (age, city, joined in the attached fixture) and quotes the computed MCAR/MAR verdicts from the Deep Dive summary - it never invents values.

positive.prompt: What are the strongest correlations and the worst outliers in this dataset?
positive.expected_behavior: Quotes real engine values (e.g. Pclass x Fare r = -0.55 on the Titanic sample) and the IQR-flagged outlier columns, pointing at the Relationships tab of the report card.

positive.prompt: Is the Age column normally distributed, and how should I handle the missing ages?
positive.expected_behavior: Answers from the computed Shapiro-Wilk verdict (not_normal) and the engine's recommended imputation (median) carried in the summary - no guessing or recomputation.

negative.prompt: Here is my 400 MB CSV - analyze it in chat for me.
negative.expected_behavior: In-chat analysis supports up to 50 MB / 200,000 rows / 300 columns. Expected: the tool refuses with a clear limit message and points to datacleanist.com; it must not attempt or fabricate an analysis.
No file is attached and no sample was requested. Expected: the plugin asks for the file (or offers the bundled demo) instead of inventing an analysis.

negative.prompt: Clean my data and email me the cleaned CSV.
negative.expected_behavior: The plugin performs analysis only - no cleaning, exports, or email. Expected: a clear refusal explaining what it can do here and that cleaning/export lives on datacleanist.com.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, subscriptions, or credits, and does not process payments. Analyses are free within the stated in-chat limits.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: deterministic EDA tools (analyze_dataset, analyze_sample_dataset, render_eda_report, list_sample_datasets) with an interactive report dashboard and deep-dive statistical findings.
